headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 20, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 24.13% compared to SPY's 12.89%. This outperformance, reflected in an average alpha of 11.24%, indicates that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 46.66%, significantly contributing to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 10.12%, which is still above the benchmark but shows less strength. This relative performance is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience against broader market movements. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
